# Packages and Functions

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
library(symebcovmf)
```

```{r}
ebnm_generalized_binary_fix_scale <- function(x, s, mode = 'estimate', g_init = NULL, fix_g = FALSE, output = ebnm_output_default(), control = NULL){
  ebnm_gb_output <- ebnm::ebnm_generalized_binary(x = x, s = s, mode = mode, 
                                                  scale = 0.01, 
                                                  g_init = g_init, fix_g = fix_g,
                                                  output = output, control = control)
  return(ebnm_gb_output)
}
```

```{r}
plot_loadings <- function(L_est, Pop, legendYN = TRUE, scales_option = "fixed"){
  # options for scales_option are "fixed" and "free_y"
  n <- nrow(L_est)
  k <- ncol(L_est)
  Idx <- rep(c(1:n), k)
  Loading <- c(L_est)
  Factor <- paste0('k=',c(sapply(c(1:k), function(x, n){rep(x, n)}, n = n)))
  Factor <- factor(Factor, levels = gtools::mixedsort(unique(Factor)))
  tib <- data.frame(Idx, Loading, Factor, Pop)
  plt <- ggplot(tib, aes(x = Idx, y = Loading, col = Pop)) +
    geom_point(show.legend = legendYN) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    facet_grid(cols = vars(Factor), scales = scales_option) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"))
  plot(plt)
}

plot_heatmap <- function(L, title = "", colors_range = c("gray96", "red"), brks = NULL){
  ### define the color map
  cols <- colorRampPalette(colors_range)(49)
  if (is.null(brks) == TRUE){
    brks <- seq(min(L), max(L), length=50)
  }
  
  plt <- pheatmap(L, show_rownames = FALSE, show_colnames = FALSE, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE, color = cols, breaks = brks, main = title)
  return(plt)
}
```

```{r}
permute_L <- function(est, truth){
  K_est <- ncol(est)
  K_truth <- ncol(truth)
  n <- nrow(est)

  #if estimates don't have same number of columns, try padding the estimate with zeros and make cosine similarity zero
  if (K_est < K_truth){
    est <- cbind(est, matrix(rep(0, n*(K_truth-K_est)), nrow = n))
  }

  if (K_est > K_truth){
    truth <- cbind(truth, matrix(rep(0, n*(K_est - K_truth)), nrow = n))
  }

  #normalize est and truth
  norms_est <- apply(est, 2, function(x){sqrt(sum(x^2))})
  norms_est[norms_est == 0] <- Inf

  norms_truth <- apply(truth, 2, function(x){sqrt(sum(x^2))})
  norms_truth[norms_truth == 0] <- Inf

  est_normalized <- t(t(est)/norms_est)
  truth_normalized <- t(t(truth)/norms_truth)

  #compute matrix of cosine similarities
  cosine_sim_matrix <- abs(crossprod(est_normalized, truth_normalized))
  assignment_problem <- lp.assign(t(cosine_sim_matrix), direction = "max")

  perm <- apply(assignment_problem$solution, 1, which.max)
  return(est[,perm])
}

```

```{r}
get_permutation <- function(est, truth){
  K_est <- ncol(est)
  K_truth <- ncol(truth)
  n <- nrow(est)

  #if estimates don't have same number of columns, try padding the estimate with zeros and make cosine similarity zero
  if (K_est < K_truth){
    est <- cbind(est, matrix(rep(0, n*(K_truth-K_est)), nrow = n))
  }

  if (K_est > K_truth){
    truth <- cbind(truth, matrix(rep(0, n*(K_est - K_truth)), nrow = n))
  }

  #normalize est and truth
  norms_est <- apply(est, 2, function(x){sqrt(sum(x^2))})
  norms_est[norms_est == 0] <- Inf

  norms_truth <- apply(truth, 2, function(x){sqrt(sum(x^2))})
  norms_truth[norms_truth == 0] <- Inf

  est_normalized <- t(t(est)/norms_est)
  truth_normalized <- t(t(truth)/norms_truth)

  #compute matrix of cosine similarities
  cosine_sim_matrix <- abs(crossprod(est_normalized, truth_normalized))
  assignment_problem <- lp.assign(t(cosine_sim_matrix), direction = "max")

  perm <- apply(assignment_problem$solution, 1, which.max)
  return(perm)
}
```

# Data Generation
```{r}
sim_binary_loadings_data <- function(args) {
  set.seed(args$seed)
  
  LL <- matrix(0, nrow = args$n, ncol = args$k)
  FF <- matrix(0, nrow = args$p, ncol = args$k)
  for (i in 1:args$k){
    FF[,i] <- rnorm(args$p, sd = args$group_sd[i])
    LL[,i] <- rbinom(args$n, 1, args$pi1[i])
  }
  E <- matrix(rnorm(args$n * args$p, sd = args$indiv_sd), nrow = args$n)
  Y <- LL %*% t(FF) + E
  YYt <- (1/args$p)*tcrossprod(Y)
  
  return(list(Y = Y, YYt = YYt, LL = LL, FF = FF, K = ncol(LL)))
}
```

```{r}
n <- 100
p <- 1000
k <- 10
pi1 <- rep(0.3, 10)
indiv_sd <- 1
group_sd <- rep(1, 10)
seed <- 1
sim_args = list(n = n, p = p, k = k, pi1 = pi1, indiv_sd = indiv_sd, group_sd = group_sd, seed = seed)
sim_data <- sim_binary_loadings_data(sim_args)
```

```{r}
plot_heatmap(sim_data$LL)
```

# Apply EBcovMF

```{r}
# Fit flashier with ebnm_generalized_binary on both loadings and factors
fl <- flash_init(sim_data$YYt) %>%
  flash_set_verbose(2) %>%
  flash_greedy(
    Kmax = 10,
    ebnm_fn = ebnm_generalized_binary_fix_scale
  ) %>%
  flash_backfit(extrapolate = FALSE, warmstart = TRUE, maxiter = 500)
```

## Results
```{r}
plot_heatmap(fl$L_pm, colors_range = c('blue','gray96','red'), brks = seq(-max(abs(fl$L_pm)), max(abs(fl$L_pm)), length.out = 50))
```

```{r}
plot_heatmap(fl$F_pm, colors_range = c('blue','gray96','red'), brks = seq(-max(abs(fl$L_pm)), max(abs(fl$L_pm)), length.out = 50))
```

```{r}
# Bar plot of the correlations of the the two estimates
factor_correlations <- diag(cor(fl$L_pm, fl$F_pm))

fl_scaled <- ldf(fl)
ebcovmf_permutation <- get_permutation(0.5*(fl_scaled$L + fl_scaled$F), sim_data$LL)

# Preserve the original matrix order from top to bottom on the y-axis
df <- data.frame(
  Factor = factor(paste('Factor', 1:10), levels = paste('Factor', 1:10)),
  Correlation = factor_correlations[ebcovmf_permutation]
)

ggplot(df, aes(x = Correlation, y = Factor)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = Correlation), width = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166ac", mid = "#f7f7f7", high = "#b2182b",
    midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Correlation"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Correlation",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Factor Estimate Correlations"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)
  )
```


```{r}
# Correlation heatmap between first loadings estimate and the true loadings
cor_mat1 <- cor(fl$L_pm[,ebcovmf_permutation], sim_data$LL)
rownames(cor_mat1) <- paste('Estimated Factor', 1:10)
colnames(cor_mat1) <- paste('True Factor', 1:10)
cor_df1 <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_mat1))
colnames(cor_df1) <- c("Estimate", "True", "Correlation")
```

```{r}
num1 <- sub(".*?([0-9]+)$", "\\1", cor_df1$Estimate)
num2 <- sub(".*?([0-9]+)$", "\\1", cor_df1$True)

is_diag_match <- (num1 == num2) & grepl("[0-9]+$", cor_df1$Estimate) & grepl("[0-9]+$", cor_df1$True)

cor_df1$diag_label <- ifelse(
  is_diag_match,
  sprintf("%.2f", cor_df1$Correlation),
  ""
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(cor_df1, aes(x = Estimate, y = True, fill = Correlation)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  # Add text only where Var1 == Var2
  geom_text(aes(label = diag_label), color = "black", size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  # Diverging color scale centered at 0
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166ac", 
    mid = "#f7f7f7", 
    high = "#b2182b", 
    midpoint = 0, 
    limits = c(-1, 1),
    name = "Correlation"
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)
  )
```

# Apply EBCD-direct

```{r}
symebcovmf_fit <- sym_ebcovmf_fit(S = sim_data$YYt, ebnm_fn = ebnm_generalized_binary_fix_scale, K = 10, maxiter = 100, rank_one_tol = 10^(-5), tol = 10^(-5), refit_lam = TRUE)
```

```{r}
symebcovmf_backfit_fit <- sym_ebcovmf_backfit(S = sim_data$YYt,
                                              sym_ebcovmf_obj = symebcovmf_fit, ebnm_fn = ebnm_generalized_binary_fix_scale, backfit_maxiter = 100, backfit_tol = 10^(-5), optim_maxiter = 100, optim_tol = 10^(-5), refit_lam = FALSE)
```

## Results

```{r}
plot_heatmap(symebcovmf_backfit_fit$L_pm %*% diag(sqrt(symebcovmf_backfit_fit$lambda)))
```

